detect.description: Run the mechanical tell detector (node scripts/detector.mjs <target>); report error findings verbatim. Script entry: detector.mjs.

audit.description: Two-axis scored audit (Standards x Spec, parallel passes, no reranking) writing .design-skill/audit-report.md with a /24 health score.

deslop.description: Kill AI-slop tells with positive alternatives; full rewritten output plus a one-line note per fix; detector must exit 0 after.

shape.description: Grill before building: design tree, frontier rounds, every question with a recommendation; settle register, mode, persona, direction; output a confirmed brief.

craft.description: Brief-confirmed build; ability flags apply the matching doctrine; --document generates and validates DESIGN.md (google-labs-code/design.md format).
